title: Beyond prompt-only segmentation: Foundation model-guided trust-region label refinement for single-stage bone fracture instance segmentation
mechanism: Foundation-model masks are used only inside a narrow trust region around expert labels, gated by instance IoU, with minimal closing; the original annotation anchors everything.
adaptation: For crack labels: inside a 2 px band, move each label line onto the FM (or SERD / dark-ridge) crack response, reject cells with large shifts, keep source width conventions (ARTS 1.5 px, BMRK 3 px).
min_experiment: Refine train crack labels only; retrain house 5 seeds; score on original test labels. Kill if test crack IoU and relF1@2 both fall > 0.005; pass if crack IoU +0.01.
evidence: R: 5-fold CV, constrained refinement modest gain in sample-matched ablations; unconstrained MedSAM pseudo-labels degraded; mAP@0.5 0.63. E: 2022 relabelling gave +0.05 to +0.08 crack IoU.
prior_overlap: Section 5 Labels row: automatic label refinement never run; offset-tolerant CE (n.d.) is a loss, not label editing.

alt_notes.adaptation: Proposal = 5-seed ensemble or SAM2 prompted from label skeleton points; accept refinements only within 2 px of each crack label, per-component gate IoU >= 0.3. Skeleton metric becomes a candidate benchmark metric next to relF1@2.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house on trust-region refined crack labels. Baseline: house. Metric: relF1@2, strict IoU, skeleton coverage. Kill if relF1@2 gain < +0.01. About 6 GPU-h.

alt_notes.adaptation: Proposal = 5-seed house ensemble or a SAM2 / DINOv3 refiner; accept a refined crack component only inside the 2 px band of the label and if IoU with the dilated label passes a gate; otherwise keep the original component.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house trained on trust-region-refined crack labels, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU, relF1@2. Kill: crack IoU change under +0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: Convert UCF region-crack polygons and wide external crack masks to thin lines only within 2 px of the given label, gated by agreement with the EL dark ridge; never train on raw SAM crack masks.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: joint run where external crack labels are trust-region-thinned vs used raw; 5 seeds each, 30k steps. Baseline: joint run with raw labels and house 5-seed. Metric: clean-49 crack IoU and relP@2. Kill if thinning gives < +0.012 crack IoU over raw. ~15 GPU-h.
